title: A shape picked in an icon names its place and size above it
goal: The icon drawing mock labels a picked shape with where it sits and how big it is, in units, right above it (9, 10 · 6 × 3). In the app a picked shape in an icon shows no such label, so you have to look at the panel to check a shape landed where you meant.
notes: REPRODUCED 2026-11-07: temp walk drawing a box at 9, 10 to 15, 13 in a 24 frame at 800%, then the Select tool: capture queue/audits/2026-11-07-icon-snap-picked-box-sc.png shows handles and no place or size label. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html #igTag, steps 4 to 6, 9 and 10, seen at http://127.0.0.1:8791/pages/icon-draw-wt.html?step=4. Words already exist: IconSnap.readout(centre:corner:shape:). Check it against the never-cover-the-object rule and the handle hint pill that sits under the shape.
acceptance: A shape picked in an icon shows its place and size in units beside it, as the mock steps 4 to 6 do: 9, 10 · 6 × 3, and center 12, 8 · d 8 for a circle
The label moves with a drag and never sits over the shape or its handles
A walk at Next defaults proves it, with a picture beside the mock in the audit
